# The Goude Group

> AI operating partner for small and mid-size, owner-led businesses. Based in Franklin, Tennessee (Nashville area), working with clients across the United States. We find where a business loses time and money, build the systems that fix it on the tools it already uses, and keep them working.

## About

The Goude Group (Goude Group) is a business consultancy in Franklin, Tennessee. It helps owner-led companies use AI and automation to run with less drag: answering and following up with leads, quoting, scheduling, invoicing, reporting and onboarding. Work starts with a fixed-scope review of the business and continues as fixed-price builds and an ongoing monthly partnership. The firm also publishes The Briefing, a free weekly newsletter for business owners.

## Leadership

- **Gabrielle Goude, Owner**

## Services

### Operational Review
A fixed-scope review of the whole business, completed in two to three weeks. Each team lead completes an assessment, followed by interviews with the leads, the CEO and the founder. The result is one document: an Efficiency Score, a scorecard across seven areas of the business, a risk map, a map of every tool in use, a roadmap ranked by hours and dollars across three horizons, a Build Book with one page per recommendation, and a priced proposal. A full sample: https://goudegroup.com/roofing-review/

### AI and automation builds
Fixed-price systems built on the tools a business already owns where possible: missed-call text back, speed-to-lead response, website chat, appointment reminders, review requests, lead reactivation, quote and proposal follow-up, AI phone answering, inbox triage, meeting notes to tasks, owner dashboards, staff onboarding, invoice and payment reminders, and receipt and bookkeeping prep. Most go live in 5 to 21 days and include 30 days of tuning.

### AI Operating Partnership (retainer)
An embedded AI department after the review: an initial term, then month to month. We build the roadmap in order of return, run and maintain what we build, scope new work as the business changes, and report through a Command Center.

### AI strategy, brand and offer
Positioning, offer design and the path to revenue for companies changing how they operate.

### Partner program
Agencies and consultants can sell the Goude Systems catalog under their own name and keep 20 percent of every build, plan and month of care: https://goudegroup.com/whitelabel/

## Free resources

- **The Briefing**: a weekly newsletter on the systems, tools, risks and commercial shifts business owners should watch. Every article includes a free tool that runs in the page, with no signup.
- **The Operating Index**: an eight-question self-assessment of how much of a business still depends on specific people instead of systems, with a full written result. Nothing is gated.
- **The phone agent**: a live AI phone agent anyone can call: https://goudegroup.com/phone-agent/

## Who we work with

Small and mid-size, owner-led businesses in the United States, from founder-led brands to operating companies doing $5M to $100M, including commercial roofing and construction, accounting and other professional services, private capital, events, media and sales organizations.

## How we work

- We build on software the client already pays for, and say so when a feature they own already does the job.
- Every recommendation shows its math in the client's own numbers. We do not guarantee outcomes.
- Client data stays in the client's own accounts.
- Nothing is sent on a client's behalf without wording they approved.

## Location

Franklin, Tennessee (Nashville area). Serving clients nationwide.
